scope: Document and figure regeneration using only tracked repository files; raw climate simulations were not rerun.
environment: Existing project Python dependencies and Node.js; no ignored raw inputs, local evidence directories or node_modules copied.

verification.scope: Numerical reporting, provenance and outcome-specific evaluation; end-to-end grain-loss predictive validity is not established
verification.Results_focus: Predictive support, canopy damage, production exposure and crop–disease timing

full_grid_domain_check.source: Bundled paired grid values and valid-year counts

production_exposure_and_timing.timing_population: Identical complete pairs for all event and interval means
production_exposure_and_timing.production_interpretation: Fixed baseline production located in exposed cells; not estimated grain loss

comparison_basis: PDF and DOCX text, uncompressed CSV bytes, exact PNG and caption bytes. Archive timestamps and PDF creation metadata need not match.
